records.subject: AG_ED
records.title: Introduction to Agricultural Education
records.description: Introduction to Agricultural Education Model, requirements for becoming an agricultural teacher; roles of the agricultural teacher.

records.subject: AG_ED
records.title: Student Teaching in Agricultural Education
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: AG ED 440; AG ED 450; AG ED 471; senior standing.
records.description: Supervised teaching in public schools including seminars reflecting effective teaching.  Required preparation:  Includes applying; paying certification fees; completing all other coursework for degree and teacher certification; receiving fingerprint clearance from WSP, FBI, and Office of Professional Practices; maintaining 2.5 GPA overall and in endorsement and professional core classes.  Placement by interview only.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: AG_ED
records.title: Reinforcing Core Academics in Agricultural Education
records.description: Strategies of reinforcing core academics in secondary agricultural education. This course leads to CASE certification.

records.subject: AG_ED
records.title: Applied Instructional Strategies in Agricultural Education
records.description: Introduction to agriculture, food, and natural resource systems, and strategies for reinforcing core academics in secondary education. Leads to CASE certification in AFNR.

records.subject: AG_ED
records.title: Principles of Career and Technical Education
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: TCH LRN 464 or concurrent enrollment; TCH LRN 465 or concurrent enrollment; TCH LRN 466 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Local, state, and national vocational technical educational legislation, policies, programs, and organizations.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: AG_ED
records.title: Planning, Curriculum, and Techniques in Ag Ed
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: TCH LRN 301; TCH LRN 317; admitted to teacher education (Secondary Education).
records.description: Focus on career and technical education program planning, curriculum development, and instructional techniques for agricultural education programs.

records.subject: AG_ED
records.title: Student Organizations in Agricultural Education
records.description: Role of Future Farmers of America (FFA) in student organizations; role of advisor; principles of leadership; characteristics of successful FFA chapters. Course equivalent to OSU's Ag 421/521.

records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
